lesson: In window_p95, unconditionally discard the top 2 samples from each 60-sample window and compute the nearest-rank p95 over the remaining 58; clamping, conditional dropping, 5% trimming, and dropping only 1 sample were rejected.
why: The hypervisor injects exactly two warmup spikes into every 60-sample window, which statistical outlier clamping failed to resolve.
quote: every window, drop the top 2, nearest-rank p95 on the remaining 58. Not top 1, not a 5% trim, not clamping.
